dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Paimon's right! Let's hope everything goes just as you say.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, we'll come by to see you again soon, Haniyyah!

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: No problem at all! If you have a moment before you visit, send me a letter and let me know what you'd like to eat. As long as it's an ingredient found in Sumeru, I'll make sure to have it bought and ready for you.
